verdict.rationale: Netlify ships an official CLI with a documented headless deploy command (`netlify deploy --allow-anonymous`), a REST API pitched as 'ideal for automating workflows', and git-driven auto-deploys with PR previews. Community users corroborate the automated builds and deploys. However, nothing explicitly documents CI-specific auth (e.g. token env vars) or non-interactive flags beyond anonymous deploy, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless auth documentation (access tokens/env vars in pipelines), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration of running the CLI inside CI.
